description: Non-secret resolved values are part of the invocation identity, so an unchanged value set hits its own entry: a state holding the entry derived under value set A is refreshed with --resolve-from A again; the key and every identity component (the resolved-values fingerprint of A among them) are unchanged, the entry is rewritten byte-identical with the resolved values in it unredacted, nothing is removed as stale, and stdout and stderr are pinned byte for byte
